1) (Currently amended) A composition comprising the active ingredient of formula I, wherein the active ingredient is a 5-(7-methoxy-3,3-dimethyl-2,3-dihydro-1-benzoxepin-5-yl)-3-methyl-penta-2,4-dienoic compound, and/or a physiologically acceptable salt thereof, and one or more skin-tolerated vehicles.

3) (Currently amended) A composition for topical use comprising a) the active ingredient according to Claim 1, b) one or more skin-tolerated vehicles, and c) optionally one or more further active compounds having a skin-care and/or inflammation-inhibiting action, wherein the further active compounds are selected from the group consisting of retinoids, peptides, or anti-inflammatory agents.

4) (Currently amended) A composition according to one or more of Claims 1 or 3, wherein the active ingredient is contained in said composition in an amount of 0.00001 to 10 per cent by weight.

6) (Currently amended) A composition according to Claim 5, comprising as a further skin-care ingredient ectoine, preferably in an amount of 0.01 to 10 per cent by weight, more preferably 0.1 to 5 per cent by weight and especially 0.1 to 2 per cent by weight.

7) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the manufacture of a cosmetic composition suitable for the treatment of skin conditions.

8) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the preparation of a composition which is suitable for the prophylaxis or treatment of skin diseases which are associated with defective keratinisation relating to differentiation and cell proliferation, in particular for the treatment of acne vulgaris, and wherein the treatment efficacy is based on preliminary clinical data.

9) (Currently amended) Use according to Claim 8 for hair care and/or hair follicle development.

10) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the care, preservation or improvement of the general state of the skin or hair, wherein said use involves formulations that enhance skin barrier functions.

11) (Currently amended) Use of active ingredient of Claim 1 as a skin lightening active agent that operates through modulation of skin melanin levels.

12) (Currently amended) Use of the composition according to Claim 1 for skin lightening or improvement of skin tone uniformity.

13) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the prophylaxis against or reduction of skin unevenness, such as wrinkles or fine lines associated with aging or environmental damage.

14) (Currently amended) Use of the active ingredient of Claim 1 for the prophylaxis against time- or light-induced aging processes of the human skin or hair, with an emphasis on reducing the appearance of photoaging effects.
